about: The first album by Sly and the Family Stone, produced by Sly Stone for Epic. It drew mixed reviews and failed to chart, prompting label head Clive Davis to ask for a more commercial approach, which led to Dance to the Music.

title: Autoamerican
label: Chrysalis Records
personnel: Chris Stein – guitar, tympani Jimmy Destri – piano, organ, synthesizer
Frank Infante – guitar, background vocals Nigel Harrison – bass, background vocals Clem Burke – drums, background vocals
about: Blondie's fifth album, produced by Mike Chapman for Chrysalis and marked by wide stylistic experiments. It yielded two US chart-topping singles, the reggae cover The Tide Is High and the early rap crossover Rapture.

title: Jay & Kai + 6: The Jay And Kai Trombone Octet
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Johnson & Kai Winding – trombone, trombonium. Urbie Green, Bob Alexander, Eddie Bert, Jimmy Cleveland, Tom Mitchell, Bart Varsalona – trombone

tracks.t: All At Once You Love Her
Surrey With The Fringe On Top
You Don't Know What Love Is
The Continental (You Kiss While You're Dancing)

about: A Columbia jazz album led by trombonists J. J. Johnson and Kai Winding, who fronted an octet of trombones plus a rhythm section. It was recorded in April 1956 with George Avakian producing and followed their earlier Trombone for Two.

title: Boy With Lots Of Brass
label: Mercury Records
about: A 1957 EmArcy big band record led by Canadian trumpeter Maynard Ferguson, with vocalist Irene Kral appearing on some tracks. It presents a dozen standards in charts written by arrangers including Al Cohn, Bill Holman, Willie Maiden and Ernie Wilkins.

artist: Dave McKenna Quartet Featuring Zoot Sims
title: Saxophone
label: Chiaroscuro Records
personnel: Zoot Sims – tenor saxophone, soprano saxophone
about: A Chiaroscuro Records session cut in New York in October 1974 and produced by Hank O'Neal. Pianist Dave McKenna leads a quartet with Zoot Sims on tenor and soprano sax, Major Holley on bass and Ray Mosca on drums.
artistKey: Dave McKenna Quartet Featuring Zoot Sims

title: Walk Softly / Run Wild!
label: Jasmine Records
about: An orchestral jazz LP issued by Coral in 1959 under arranger and composer Johnny Richards, best known for his writing for Stan Kenton. It showcases his big band arrangements, recorded in New York in 1959.

title: Boy
label: Island Records
personnel: The Edge – guitar, backing vocals, glockenspiel
about: The first full-length record by Irish rock band U2, issued by Island Records in 1980 and produced by Steve Lillywhite. Its songs deal with adolescence and growing up, and it includes the single I Will Follow.

title: No Secrets
label: Elektra

tracks.t: His Friends Are More Than Fond Of Robin

about: Carly Simon's commercial breakthrough, produced by Richard Perry and recorded in London for Elektra. It held the top spot on the Billboard 200 for five weeks, and its lead single You're So Vain became a number-one hit in the US.

title: Scobey And Clancy
label: Good Time Jazz

tracks.t: When That Midnight Choo-Choo Leaves For Alabam'
Ain't Gonna Give You None Of My Jelly Roll
I Want To Go Back To Michigan (Down On The Farm)

about: A Dixieland LP on the Good Time Jazz label from trumpeter Bob Scobey's San Francisco band. Banjoist and singer Clancy Hayes handles vocals on most of its eleven tracks.

tracks.t: El Tonto En La Colina (The Fool On The Hill)
Sabor A Mi (Be True To Me)
Dream A Little Dream Of Me

title: Sign "O" The Times
label: Paisley Park Records
personnel: Prince – lead vocals and various instruments
Sheila E. – drums and percussion (10), percussion and rap (15) Eric Leeds – saxophone

tracks.t: I Could Never Take The Place Of Your Man
It's Gonna Be A Beautiful Night

about: A double album by Prince, released by Paisley Park and Warner Bros. after he disbanded the Revolution. Drawing on funk, rock, soul and pop, it was built from several abandoned projects and is widely ranked among his finest work.

title: Rendezvous
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: Thank You For A Lovely Evening

about: A Capitol LP of mood music featuring cornetist Bobby Hackett, with arrangements and conducting by Glenn Osser. It belongs to the series of lush, ballad-oriented records Hackett made for Capitol in the 1950s.

title: Color Me Barbra
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: I've Grown Accustomed To Her Face
Let's Face The Music And Dance
Sam, You Made The Pants Too Long
I Stayed Too Long At The Fair

about: A Columbia album by Barbra Streisand tied to her first CBS television special broadcast in color. It reached number three in the US, went gold, and earned Grammy nominations, including Album of the Year.

title: No Count Sarah
label: Mercury Records
personnel: Sarah Vaughan - vocals. The Count Basie Orchestra: Wendell Culley, Thad Jones, Snooky Young & Joe Newman - trumpet Henry Coker, Al Grey & Benny Powell - trombone
Sonny Payne - drums. Marshal Royal, Frank Foster, Billy Mitchell, Charlie Fowlkes, Frank Wess - sax
about: A vocal jazz record by Sarah Vaughan, taped in New York in August 1957 and issued two years later on EmArcy. She is backed by members of the Count Basie band without Basie himself, hence the playful title.

title: Desolation Angels
label: Swan Song Records
personnel: Paul Rodgers – vocals, guitar, piano, synthesisers Mick Ralphs – guitar, keyboards Boz Burrell – bass Simon Kirke – drums
about: The English hard rock group Bad Company released this on Swan Song, taking its title from a Jack Kerouac novel. Featuring the hit Rock 'n' Roll Fantasy, it climbed to number three in the US and was their final top-ten album.

title: Easy
label: Capitol Records
personnel: Nancy Wilson - vocals Jimmy Jones - arranger, conductor

tracks.t: Make Me A Present Of You
When I Look In Your Eyes

about: A Capitol release by Nancy Wilson, arranged and conducted mainly by Jimmy Jones and produced by David Cavanaugh. It opens and closes with Jobim songs, made the top five of the R&B album chart, and includes the single Face It Girl, It's Over.

title: Ghost In The Machine
label: A&M Records
personnel: Sting – bass guitar, lead vocals, double bass, keyboards, saxophone
Andy Summers – guitar, backing vocals, keyboards

tracks.t: Every Little Thing She Does Is Magic
Hungry For You (J'Aurais Toujours Faim De Toi)

about: The Police's fourth record, made in Montserrat with producer Hugh Padgham, adds horns and synthesizers to the trio's sound. It topped the UK chart and produced hits such as Every Little Thing She Does Is Magic and Spirits in the Material World.

label: XL Recordings

tracks.t: Send My Love (To Your New Lover)

about: English singer Adele's third album, released by XL Recordings, reflects on nostalgia and regret. Led by the single Hello, it broke first-week sales records in the US and UK and won the Grammy for Album of the Year.

title: Joan Armatrading
label: A&M Records
personnel: Peter Wood – Hammond organ, piano, electric piano
about: Joan Armatrading's self-titled third album, produced by Glyn Johns and recorded in London for A&M. It reached number twelve in the UK, went gold, and contains her biggest-selling single, Love and Affection.

title: Heartbeat City
label: Elektra Records
about: The fifth album by Boston new wave band the Cars, co-produced with Robert John Mutt Lange and issued by Elektra. Its polished synth-pop sound yielded several hits, among them Drive, You Might Think and Magic.

title: Pretenders II
label: Sire Records
personnel: Chrissie Hynde — rhythm guitar, lead vocals James Honeyman-Scott — lead guitar, keyboards, backing vocals Pete Farndon — bass guitar, backing vocals Martin Chambers — drums, backing vocals
about: The Pretenders' second album, the last made by the original lineup before two members died. Produced by Chris Thomas, it includes songs such as Message of Love, Talk of the Town and I Go to Sleep.

title: Made In The Shade
label: Rolling Stones Records
personnel: Keith Richards – electric and acoustic guitars
Mick Taylor – electric, acoustic, bass and slide guitar
about: A greatest-hits set issued on the Rolling Stones' own label, gathering tracks from their early-1970s albums from Sticky Fingers through It's Only Rock 'n Roll. It was the band's first official compilation drawn from that era.

title: Songs From The Big Chair
label: Warner Bros Records

tracks.t: Everybody Wants To Rule The World

about: Tears for Fears' second album, produced by Chris Hughes, moved the duo toward a broader pop-rock sound. It reached number one in the US and produced the hits Shout, Everybody Wants to Rule the World and Head over Heels.

title: Purple Rain
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Lisa Coleman, Matt Fink – keyboards, vocals
about: Prince's sixth album and the first billed with his band the Revolution, serving as the soundtrack to the film of the same name. It spent months at number one in the US and contains When Doves Cry, Let's Go Crazy and the title song.

title: This Is How It Is
label: Traffic Entertainment Group
personnel: Ski (David Anthony Willis/Ski Beatz) Suave Lover
about: The first album by the hip hop group Original Flavor, released on Atlantic and produced by member Ski. It was recorded in Brooklyn and Manhattan in 1991 and 1992 and was followed by Beyond Flavor in 1994.

title: For Once In My Life
label: Liberty

tracks.t: Medley: For Once In My Life / After Today
Yesterday I Heard The Rain (Esta Tarde Vi Llover)
Medley: Come Rain Or Come Shine / This Girl's In Love With You
Can't Take My Eyes Off You
The Other Man's Grass Is Always Greener
Medley: Some Of These Days / After You've Gone

about: A 1969 Liberty Records LP by Vikki Carr, captured in concert and opening with a medley built around the Stevie Wonder hit that gives the record its name. The set mixes contemporary pop covers such as Happy Together with standards and Latin-tinged material.

title: John Barleycorn Must Die
label: United Artists Records
personnel: Steve Winwood - vocals, guitar, bass , organ, piano, electric piano
Jim Capaldi - drums, percussion, tambourine, vocals
Chris Wood - saxophone, flute, organ, percussion
about: Traffic's 1970 comeback record, which began as a Steve Winwood solo project before the band reconvened. Named after a traditional English folk song it adapts, it reached the top five in the United States, the group's best American chart showing, and earned a gold certification.

title: Beautiful Noise
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Neil Diamond – vocals, guitarguitar, dobro. Richard Bennett, Robbie Robertson, Jesse Ed Davis – guitar Bob Boucher - bass
Larry Knechtel, Alan Lindgren, David Paich – piano. Dennis St
John, Jim Keltner, Russ Kunkel, Jim Gordon – drums
Garth Hudson – Hammond organ, Lowrey organ

tracks.t: If You Know What I Mean

about: Neil Diamond's 1976 Columbia album, produced by Robbie Robertson of The Band and pitched as a comeback. It reflects on his early songwriting days in New York, topped charts in several countries, reached number four in the US and went platinum there.

title: The Singles
label: Bikini Kill Records
about: A short Kill Rock Stars collection issued after Bikini Kill split, gathering three singles from 1993 and 1995. Joan Jett produced and played on the opening tracks, and critics responded warmly both on release and when it was reissued in 2018.

title: Pottymouth
label: Kill Rock Stars
personnel: Abby Weems – lead vocals, guitar Ally Einbinder – bass Victoria Mandanas – drums, backing vocals
about: Bratmobile's first full-length record, released on Kill Rock Stars and recorded mostly in Washington, DC in 1992. A raw, lo-fi punk set that includes a cover of the Runaways' Cherry Bomb, it is now regarded as a landmark of the riot grrrl movement.

title: Californication
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: John Frusciante – guitar, backing vocals, keyboards Flea – bass , backing vocals Chad Smith – drums, shaker, cowbell, woodblock, tambourine
about: Produced by Rick Rubin, this Warner Bros. release marked guitarist John Frusciante's return and steered the Red Hot Chili Peppers toward a more melodic sound. Driven by singles like Scar Tissue and Otherside, it became their biggest seller, moving well over 15 million copies worldwide.

title: You Haunt Me
label: Cherrytree Records
personnel: Landon Jacobs Jason Suwito Hayden Coplen
about: The first full-length release from Los Angeles-area indie pop trio Sir Sly, self-produced and issued by Interscope in 2014. Its moody, electronic-leaning songs include the title single, which became an alternative radio hit for the band.

title: Channel Orange
label: Island Def Jam Music Group
personnel: Om'Mas Keith, Shea Taylor, Pharrell Williams – keyboards
André 3000, Taylor Johnson, John Mayer – guitars
about: Frank Ocean's first studio album, released by Def Jam in 2012 after his mixtape Nostalgia, Ultra. Widely acclaimed as one of the best records of its year, it debuted at number two in the US and won the Grammy for Best Urban Contemporary Album.

title: Hello, I Must Be Going!
label: Atlantic Records

tracks.t: Do You Know, Do You Care?
Don't Let Him Steal Your Heart Away

about: Phil Collins's second solo record, following Face Value and co-produced with Hugh Padgham. Its cover of You Can't Hurry Love topped the UK singles chart, and the album reached number two in Britain and went triple platinum in both the UK and US.

title: Tattoo You
label: Rolling Stones Records
about: A Rolling Stones album assembled largely from reworked outtakes dating back through the 1970s, finished with new vocals and overdubs. Led by the single Start Me Up, it spent weeks at number one in the US, the band's most recent chart-topper there, and its cover won a Grammy.

title: It's Uptown
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Bennie Green – trombone Lonnie Smith – organ
about: George Benson's second album and his first for Columbia, produced by John Hammond and recorded in early 1966 with a quartet featuring organist Lonnie Smith and baritone saxophonist Ronnie Cuber. The soul-jazz set also showcases Benson singing on a few tracks.

title: Murmur
label: I.R.S. Records
personnel: Bill Berry – drums, backing vocals, percussion, bass guitar, piano Peter Buck – electric & acoustic guitars Mike Mills – bass , backing vocals, piano, organ, acoustic guitar
about: R.E.M.'s first full-length album, issued by I.R.S. Records and produced by Mitch Easter and Don Dixon in North Carolina. Its murky, jangling sound won wide critical praise, including Rolling Stone's album of the year honor, and it later went gold.

title: Movin'
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: On A Slow Boat To China

about: A 1959 Capitol LP marking Kay Starr's return to the label after her RCA Victor years. Produced by Dave Cavanaugh with a big band conducted by Van Alexander, it presents her as a swinging jazz-pop vocalist on travel-themed material.

title: Whipped Cream & Other Delights
label: A&M Records
about: A 1965 A&M release by Herb Alpert's Tijuana Brass, famed for its cover photo of a model draped in what appears to be whipped cream. It held the top spot on the US album chart for eight weeks, stayed on the chart for years and sold millions.

artist: Terry Snyder And The All Stars
title: Persuasive Percussion
label: Command
personnel: The Command All – Stars Primary Artist

tracks.t: I'm In The Mood For Love

about: A 1959 stereo showcase LP on Enoch Light's Command Records, played by studio musicians led by drummer Terry Snyder. Designed to show off ping-pong stereo effects, it topped Billboard's stereo album chart for months in 1960 and launched a series of follow-ups.
artistKey: Terry Snyder And The All Stars

title: Main Course
label: RSO Records
personnel: Barry Gibb – vocals, rhythm guitar Robin Gibb – vocals Maurice Gibb – bass, lead guitar, rhythm guitar, vocals
about: Produced by Arif Mardin, this RSO album moved the Bee Gees toward R&B, funk and disco and introduced Barry Gibb's falsetto in a prominent way. Featuring Jive Talkin' and Nights on Broadway, it revived the group's fortunes, especially in America.

title: Tap Root Manuscript
label: MCA Records

tracks.t: He Ain't Heavy... He's My Brother

about: Neil Diamond's 1970 Uni album, carried by his first chart-topping single, Cracklin' Rosie. Its second side is an extended African-inspired suite that anticipated later world-music experiments by Western pop artists, and the album eventually went platinum.

title: Spank Your Blank Blank
label: Parachute Records
personnel: Maurice Commander – conductor, electric piano, piano, producer
Martin L. Dumas, Jr. – backing vocals, rhythm guitar
about: The first album by Chicago disco and funk performer Morris Jefferson, issued in 1978 on Parachute Records. Its title track had come out as a single and reached the lower half of the Billboard R&B top 40.

title: Live Convention '80
label: Disco Wax Records
personnel: DJ Cool Clyde, DJ Lightnin Lance, the Hypnotizing 3, Lil Sha Rock, Grandmaster Caz, JDL, and Kay Gee (of the Cold Crush Brothers), Whipper Whip, Ruby Dee, and Grand Wizard Theodore (of the Fantastic Five Freaks), the Soul Sonic Force, and the Nice and Nasty Four

tracks.t: Only So Much Oil In The Ground
I Won't Leave Unless You Want Me To
(To Say The Least) You're The Most
It Can Never Be The Same

title: AM
label: Domino Records
personnel: Alex Turner Matt Helders Jamie Cook Nick O'Malley

tracks.t: Why'd You Only Call Me When You're High?

about: Arctic Monkeys' 2013 Domino release, produced by James Ford, which brought hip-hop and R&B rhythms into their rock sound. It debuted at number one in the UK, became their biggest US success, and won the Brit Award for British Album of the Year.

title: Roberta Flack Featuring Donny Hathaway
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Roberta Flack – vocals, keyboards, synthesizers. Ray Chew, Paul Griffin, Raymond Jones, Harry Whitaker – keyboards. Hubert Eaves III, Ronnie Foster, Ed Walsh– synthesizers Stevie Wonder – keyboards, drums, backing vocals Hiram Bullock, Reggie Lucas, Jeff Mironov, John Tropea – guitar Eluriel "Tinker" Barfield, Basil Fearrington, Anthony Jackson – bass Errol "Crusher" Bennett – percussion

tracks.t: Don't Make Me Wait Too Long

about: Planned as a second duet record, this Atlantic album became a Roberta Flack project with Donny Hathaway as guest after his death in 1979. It includes their duets Back Together Again and You Are My Heaven, earned a gold certification and revived Flack's commercial standing.

title: Get Close
label: Real Records

tracks.t: How Much Did You Get For Your Soul?

about: The Pretenders' 1986 album, made with several producers including Bob Clearmountain and Jimmy Iovine and leaning toward a funkier sound. It contains Don't Get Me Wrong and Hymn to Her and reached the UK top ten.

title: The Lemon Of Pink
label: Temporary Residence Limited
personnel: Paul de Jong – music, mastering, mixing Nick Zammuto – music, mastering, mixing

tracks.t: The Future, Wouldn't That Be Nice
A True Story Of A Story Of True Love

about: The second album by the Books, released on the German label Tomlab in 2003. It blends acoustic instruments with found sound and spoken-word samples, and it drew strong reviews, with Pitchfork placing it among the top records of its year.

title: Dream With Dean
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Dean Martin – vocals Ken Lane - piano Barney Kessel - guitar Red Mitchell - double bass Irving Cottler - drums

tracks.t: If You Were The Only Girl
Baby Won't You Please Come Home

about: An intimate small-combo record on Reprise, produced by Jimmy Bowen, with Dean Martin backed by a quartet led by pianist Ken Lane. It climbed to No. 15 on the Billboard 200, and his reworked version of its song Everybody Loves Somebody later topped the Hot 100.

title: Roberta Flack & Donny Hathaway
label: Atlantic Records
about: A duet project by Roberta Flack and Donny Hathaway issued by Atlantic and produced by Joel Dorn and Arif Mardin. Its single Where Is the Love reached the US top five and earned the pair a Grammy, while their take on You've Got a Friend was also a hit.

title: Contradiction
label: Mercury Records
personnel: Billy Beck – piano, Clavinet, Synthesizer, vocals James "Diamond" Williams – drums, timbales, congas, cowbells, steel drums, temple blocks, vocals. Marvin "Merv" Pierce – trumpets, trombones. Marshall "Rock" Jones – bass. Ralph "Pee Wee" Middlebrooks – trumpets Clarence "Satch" Satchell – flute, alto saxophone, tenor saxophone. Leroy "Sugarfoot" Bonner – guitars, harmonica, percussion, vocals
about: A self-produced funk record by the Ohio Players released on Mercury. It went to No. 1 on the Billboard soul albums chart and No. 12 on the main LP chart, helped by the R&B chart-topping single Who'd She Coo?.

title: Welcome To My World
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Dean Martin – vocals Jimmy Bowen - producer Bill Justis, Billy Strange, H.B

tracks.t: In The Chapel In The Moonlight
Release Me (And Let Me Love Again)
The Green, Green Grass Of Home

about: Dean Martin's second album of 1967, produced by Jimmy Bowen for Reprise and leaning toward country-flavoured pop. It peaked at No. 20 on the Billboard 200, and In the Chapel in the Moonlight led the Adult Contemporary chart.

title: Like Blue
label: MGM Records

tracks.t: (What Did I Do To Be So) Black And Blue
Between The Devil And The Deep Blue Sea
The Blue Subterranean (Why Are We So Afraid?)

about: An MGM LP pairing André Previn's piano with David Rose's orchestra in a set of songs built around the theme of the blues and the color blue. It was recorded at RCA Victor's Hollywood studios with Al Schmitt engineering.

title: Sinatra & Company
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Frank Sinatra – vocals Antônio Carlos Jobim – guitar, scat singing

tracks.t: Someone To Light Up My Life
Don't Ever Go Away (Por Causa De Voce)
One Note Samba (Samba De Uma Nota So)

about: A Reprise album issued around Frank Sinatra's brief retirement, collecting bossa nova sessions with Antonio Carlos Jobim arranged by Eumir Deodato alongside contemporary pop songs produced by Don Costa. The material was recorded in Hollywood between 1969 and 1970.

title: Drums Of Passion
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: Odun De! Odun De! (Happy New Year)
Shango (Chant To The God Of Thunder)

about: Babatunde Olatunji's Columbia recording of Nigerian percussion and chant, cut in New York in 1959. Credited with bringing African music to a wide Western audience, it sold millions and was later added to the US National Recording Registry; its track Jin-go-lo-ba became his signature piece.

title: Business As Usual
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Greg Ham – flute, keyboards, saxophone, vocals

tracks.t: I Can See It In Your Eyes
People Just Love To Play With Words

about: Men at Work's first album, produced by Peter McIan and featuring the hits Who Can It Be Now? and Down Under. It topped the Australian chart for nine weeks and the US Billboard 200 for fifteen, and also reached No. 1 in Britain.

title: Selling England By The Pound
label: Charisma Records
personnel: Peter Gabriel – vocals, flute, oboe, percussion Tony Banks – keyboards, 12-string guitar Steve Hackett – electric guitar, nylon guitar Michael Rutherford – 12-string guitar, bass, electric sitar Phil Collins – drums, assorted percussion, vocals

tracks.t: I Know What I Like (In Your Wardrobe)
The Cinema Show / Aisle Of Plenty

about: A progressive rock album by Genesis recorded at Island Studios in London and released on Charisma. It reached No. 3 in the UK and yielded the band's first hit single, I Know What I Like (In Your Wardrobe).

title: The Very Best Of Martin Denny
label: United Artists Records

tracks.t: Hawaiian Wedding Song (Ke Kali Nei Aul)

about: A United Artists compilation of Martin Denny's exotica and easy-listening recordings. Its twelve tracks include his signature Quiet Village along with versions of Bali Ha'i, Ebb Tide and Tiny Bubbles.

title: I Never Loved A Man The Way I Love You
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Aretha Franklin – piano, vocals Spooner Oldham – keyboards, piano
Jimmy Johnson, Chips Moman – guitar Tommy Cogbill – bass
Gene Chrisman, Roger Hawkins – drums Melvin Lastie – trumpet
Charles Chalmers, King Curtis – saxophone Willie Bridges(cid:9) – saxophone

tracks.t: I Never Loved A Man (The Way I Love You)
Don't  Let Me Lose This Dream
Do Right Woman - Do Right Man

about: Aretha Franklin's first album for Atlantic, produced by Jerry Wexler, with sessions begun at FAME Studios in Muscle Shoals and finished in New York. Driven by her chart-topping version of Respect, it reached No. 2 on the Billboard 200 and No. 1 on the R&B list.

tracks.t: Between The Devil & The Deep Blue Sea

title: Night Music
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Kapono (Henry Kapono Ka’aihue Cecilio (Cecilio David Rodriguez)

tracks.t: Have You Ever Had That Feelin'

about: The third album by Hawaiian duo Cecilio & Kapono and their last for Columbia. Produced with Bruce Botnick and Terry Powell, it features mostly original songs and guest players such as saxophonist Tom Scott.

title: Parsley, Sage, Rosemary And Thyme
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: The Big Bright Green Pleasure Machine
Flowers Never Bend With The Rainfall
For Emily, Whenever I May Find Her
A Poem On The Underground Wall

about: A folk rock album by Simon & Garfunkel produced by Bob Johnston for Columbia. It includes Homeward Bound and Scarborough Fair/Canticle, peaked at No. 4 in the US and was later certified triple platinum.

title: Quiet Village
label: Liberty
personnel: Augie Colon – bongos, congas, bird calls Julius Wechter – vibes, marimba, percussion

tracks.t: My Little Grass Shack In Kealakekua, Hawaii Cha Cha Cha

about: An exotica album by Martin Denny released on Liberty and produced by Si Waronker. Built around his hit arrangement of Quiet Village, it charted on both the mono and stereo Billboard album lists, reaching No. 12 in stereo.

title: The Story Of A Young Heart
label: Jive Records
personnel: Mike Score – lead vocals, keyboards, guitar Frank Maudsley – bass guitar Paul Reynolds lead guitar Ali Score – drums

tracks.t: The Story Of A Young Heart
The More You Live, The More You Love

about: A Flock of Seagulls' third album, produced by Steve Lovell for Jive. It produced the singles The More You Live, the More You Love and Never Again (The Dancer), and peaked at No. 30 in the UK and No. 66 in the US.

title: Too Shy (Midnight Mix)
label: EMI America
about: An extended 12-inch version of Too Shy, the debut single by Kajagoogoo, produced by Nick Rhodes and Colin Thurston for EMI. The song reached No. 1 in the UK and several other countries and No. 5 on the US Hot 100.

title: Fancy Meeting You Here
label: RCA Victor
personnel: Bing Crosby – vocal Rosemary Clooney – vocal Billy May – arranger, conductor

tracks.t: On A Slow Boat To China
You Came A Long Way From St. Louis
Love Won't Let You Get Away
Love Won't Let You Get Away

about: A travel-themed duet album by Bing Crosby and Rosemary Clooney on RCA Victor, arranged and conducted by Billy May. Sammy Cahn and Jimmy Van Heusen supplied new material and reworked lyrics for standards, making it an early concept record.

title: Sign "O" The Times Maxi-Single
label: Paisley Park Records

tracks.t: La, La, La, He, He, Hee (Highly Explosive)

about: The title song from Prince's 1987 album, issued by Paisley Park and Warner Bros. with La, La, La, He, He, Hee on the flip side. Its sparse track tackles AIDS, drugs, gang violence and nuclear fear, and it reached No. 3 in the US.

title: San Antonio Rose
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: I'll Be There (If You Ever Want Me)
Don't You Ever Get Tired (Of Hurting Me)

about: A country duet album by Willie Nelson and Ray Price, produced by Nelson for Columbia and named after a Bob Wills classic Price had recorded earlier. It reached No. 3 on the country albums chart and was certified gold.

title: Guilty
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Barbra Streisand – lead vocals Barry Gibb – acoustic guitar, vocals
Albhy Galuten – synthesizers. Cornell Dupree, George Terry, Pete Carr, Lee Rienour – guitar
about: A Columbia album written and produced largely by Barry Gibb with Albhy Galuten and Karl Richardson. It topped charts in the US, UK and elsewhere, spawned the No. 1 hit Woman in Love, and became Streisand's biggest-selling album worldwide.

title: The Garland Touch
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: I Happen To Like New York
Happiness Is A Thing Called Joe
It's A Great Day For The Irish

about: Judy Garland's last studio album issued in her lifetime, released by Capitol. It combines six unreleased songs cut in London in 1960 with four previously issued tracks, and it charted in the Billboard top 40.

title: Aretha Live At Filmore West
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Brenda Bryant, Margaret Branch, Pat Smith - backing vocals

tracks.t: Spirit In The Dark (Reprise With Ray Charles)

about: A concert album recorded over three nights in March 1971 at San Francisco's Fillmore West, with King Curtis and the Kingpins backing Aretha Franklin and a guest appearance by Ray Charles. It topped the R&B album chart and reached No. 7 on the Billboard 200.

title: Chicago V
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Peter Cetera – bass guitar, wah-wah bass, vocals
Danny Seraphine – drums, congas, antique bells
about: Produced by James William Guercio, this record became Chicago's first chart-topping album in the US, holding the No. 1 spot for nine weeks. Its numbering counts the earlier Carnegie Hall live set, and it yielded the hit single Saturday in the Park.

title: Blonde On Blonde
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Bob Dylan – vocals, guitar, harmonica, piano
Charlie McCoy – bass guitar, guitar, harmonica, trumpet
Wayne Moss – guitar, vocals. Hargus "Pig" Robbins – piano, keyboards

tracks.t: One Of Us Must Know (Sooner Or Later)
Most Likely You Go Your Way And I'll Go Mine
Sad Eyed Lady Of The Lowlands

about: Bob Dylan's double LP was cut with producer Bob Johnston, starting in New York and largely finished in Nashville sessions in early 1966. It rounded out his mid-sixties electric trilogy, reached the US top ten, and is often cited as one of rock's earliest double albums.

title: C'est Chic
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Bernard Edwards And Nile Rodgers – producer, conductor
Robert Sabino – clavinet, piano, electric piano
about: Chic's second LP on Atlantic was produced by Nile Rodgers and Bernard Edwards. Powered by the chart-topping Le Freak and the hit I Want Your Love, it peaked at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 and led the US R&B albums chart for eleven weeks.

title: Good Thing
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: If It Feels Good (Then It Must Be)

about: Leon Bridges followed his retro-soul debut with this Columbia release, made with producers including Ricky Reed and Niles City Sound. It entered the Billboard 200 at No. 3, earned a Best R&B Album Grammy nomination, and its track Bet Ain't Worth the Hand won a Grammy.

title: Red Octopus
label: Grunt Records
personnel: Paul Kantner, Craig Chaquico – vocals, guitar
David Freiberg – bass, organ, synthesizer, keyboards
Pete Sears – bass, keyboards, piano, organ, clavinet

tracks.t: I Want To See Another World

about: Jefferson Starship's second record spent four nonconsecutive weeks atop the Billboard 200 and went double platinum. Its lead single Miracles, sung by Marty Balin, reached No. 3, and the album stands as the top seller by any Jefferson Airplane-related lineup.

title: Exotica Vol. III
label: Liberty Records
about: Released on Liberty Records, this third entry in Martin Denny's Exotica series continued his blend of lounge jazz, Latin and Polynesian-flavored percussion and bird-call effects. It climbed to No. 50 on the US albums chart.

title: Romantica
label: Liberty Records

tracks.t: Love, Your Magic Spell Is Everywhere

about: Romantica is a Liberty Records LP from bandleader Martin Denny, issued during his most productive period of exotica recordings. It presents his combo's lush, gentle instrumental style applied to a set of romantic material.

title: Inner Secrets
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Armando Peraza, Raul Rekow – percussion, backing vocals
about: Produced by Dennis Lambert and Brian Potter and recorded in Hollywood, Santana's tenth studio record moved toward a more straightforward rock sound than the band's earlier Latin fusion. It produced hit covers of Stormy and One Chain (Don't Make No Prison) and was certified gold.

title: Led Zeppelin II
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: John Bonham – drums, backing vocals John Paul Jones – bass guitar, organ, backing vocals Jimmy Page – guitars, theremin, backing vocals Robert Plant – lead vocals, harmonica

tracks.t: What Is And What Should Never Be
Living Loving Maid (She's Just A Woman)

about: Recorded across British and North American studios while the band toured, Led Zeppelin's second album was produced by Jimmy Page with engineer Eddie Kramer. It became their first No. 1 in both the UK and US, and the single Whole Lotta Love reached the US top five.

title: The Mix-Up
label: Capitol Records
personnel: Ad-Rock – guitars, producer, engineer, art direction MCA – bass guitar and upright basses, producer, engineer, art direction Mike D – drums, producer, engineer, art direction
about: The Beastie Boys' seventh studio album is made up entirely of instrumental tracks played by the group on live instruments. It earned them the Grammy Award for Best Pop Instrumental Album.

title: Saturday Night Fever (The Original Movie Sound Track)
label: RSO Records

tracks.t: Bee Gees How Deep Is Your Love
Bee Gees More Than A Woman
Yvonne Elliman If I Can't Have You
Walter Murphy A Fifth Of Beethoven
David Shire Night On Disco Mountain
Bee Gees You Should Be Dancing
KC & The Sunshine Band Boogie Shoes

about: This RSO double-LP soundtrack to the John Travolta film is dominated by Bee Gees songs alongside other disco acts. It topped the US chart for 24 weeks, has sold over 40 million copies worldwide, and is the only disco record to win the Grammy for Album of the Year.

title: Currents
label: Fiction Records
personnel: Kevin Parker – songwriting, performance, production, recording, mixing

tracks.t: The Less I Know The Better

about: Kevin Parker wrote, played, produced and mixed Tame Impala's third album, largely at his home studio in Fremantle. Shifting toward synth-pop, disco and R&B textures, it debuted at No. 1 in Australia and won ARIA awards including Album of the Year.

title: Face Value
label: Atlantic Records 081227953935
about: Phil Collins's first solo album, co-produced with Hugh Padgham, drew heavily on his divorce and was made during a break from Genesis. Led by In the Air Tonight, it reached No. 1 in the UK and the US top ten, selling millions.

title: Louder Than Bombs
label: Sire Records
personnel: Morrissey – vocals Johnny Marr – guitars, piano, harmonica

tracks.t: You Just Haven't Earned It Yet, Baby
Please Please Please Let Me Get What I Want
This Night Has Opened My Eyes

about: Assembled for the American market and issued by Sire, this double compilation gathers Smiths singles, B-sides and other non-album tracks. Rough Trade released it in the UK a couple of months later, and it was certified gold in both countries.

title: Random Access Memories
label: Columbia Records
about: Daft Punk's final studio album, released by Columbia, leaned on live musicianship and guests such as Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers and Giorgio Moroder. It won Grammys for Album of the Year and Best Dance/Electronica Album, while Get Lucky took Record of the Year.

title: (The) Ventures In Space
label: Dolton Records
personnel: Don Wilson - guitar Nokie Edwards - guitar Bob Bogle - bass Mel Taylor - drums
about: Issued on Dolton and produced by Bob Reisdorff, this surf instrumental record pursues a space-age theme with eerie effects. It was among the first albums on which the Ventures used Mosrite guitars, and it was later reissued by Pickwick with new artwork.

title: Politely!
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: I'll Get By (As Long As I Have You)
On The Sunny Side Of The Street
East Of The Sun (And West Of The Moon)
I Never Knew (I Could Love Anybody Like I'm Loving You)

about: Keely Smith's second solo LP for Capitol pairs her vocals with Billy May's arrangements under producer Voyle Gilmore. Its twelve traditional pop and jazz tracks alternate between swinging numbers and slower ballads.

title: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
label: Parlophone Records
personnel: John Lennon – vocals, guitars, organ, tambourine, maracas
Paul McCartney – vocals, bass, guitar, piano, organ; comb and tissue paper
George Harrison – vocals, guitar, sitar, tambura,harmonica, comb and tissue paper; handclaps, tambourine, maracas
Ringo Starr – drums, congas, tambourine, maracas, tubular bells, vocals harmonica, comb and tissue paper; final piano E chord

tracks.t: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
With A Little Help From My Friends
Lucy In The Sky With Diamonds
Being For The Benefit Of Mr. Kite
Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band (Reprise)

about: The Beatles' eighth studio album, produced by George Martin at EMI Studios, framed its songs around a fictional band. It held the UK top spot for 27 weeks, won four Grammys including Album of the Year, and has sold over 32 million copies.

title: The Wall
label: Pink Floyd Records
personnel: Roger Waters – vocals, bass , synthesizer, guitar
David Gilmour – vocals, guitars, bass, synthesizer, clavinet
Richard Wright – piano, organ, synthesizer, clavinet

tracks.t: Another Brick In The Wall Part 1
The Happiest Days Of Our Lives
Another Brick In The Wall Part 2
Another Brick In The Wall Part 3

about: Pink Floyd's double-LP rock opera traces Pink, an alienated rock star who walls himself off from the world. The last album with all four post-Barrett members, it led the US chart for 15 weeks and spawned the chart-topping Another Brick in the Wall, Part 2.

title: Be The Cowboy
label: Dead Oceans
personnel: Mitski (Mitski Miyawaki / Mitsuki Laycock) – performance Philly Phatness – horns
about: Mitski's fifth album, released by Dead Oceans and produced with longtime collaborator Patrick Hyland, packs fourteen brief art-pop songs into about half an hour. Widely acclaimed, it was her first Billboard 200 entry and features the single Nobody.

title: The Slow Rush
label: Fiction Records
personnel: Kevin Parker – songwriting, performance, production, mixing, art concept
about: Kevin Parker's fourth Tame Impala album, which he produced himself, explores time and memory across twelve tracks. It entered the US chart at No. 3, topped the Australian chart, and won five ARIA awards including Album of the Year.

title: The Getaway
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Josh Klinghoffer – guitars, backing vocals, piano
about: Red Hot Chili Peppers worked with producer Danger Mouse rather than longtime collaborator Rick Rubin on this Warner Bros. release. It debuted at No. 2 in the US and UK, included the single Dark Necessities, and was the last to feature guitarist Josh Klinghoffer.

title: Hold Space For Me
label: Mom + Pop

tracks.t: Ne Me Quitte Pas (Don't Leave Me)

about: Hold Space for Me is the first full-length album by Philadelphia-area artist Orion Sun, issued by Mom + Pop Music. Its intimate songs blend R&B, soul and lo-fi production, and it drew favorable notices from music press.
